title: The Historic Venice Beach Skate Park Is Officially BACK!
description:
Venice Beach Skate Park is officially back! 🛹

After fears that the historic skate park might be gone for good, local riders celebrated its reopening with a ribbon-cutting ceremony. The restored park features ultra-smooth pavement and new street-style benches designed with input from skaters.

More than a place to skate, the park brings people together. As one local rider shared, “It brings unity. It brings family.”

With skaters returning to the boardwalk, Venice Beach continues its legacy as a world-famous destination for skateboarding culture.
